title: CSCI 635 — Introduction to Machine Learning
subject: Artificial Intelligence
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define supervised machine learning workflows and explain how to prevent data leakage through proper preprocessing and cross-validation.
Explain the core components of machine learning evaluation metrics and their relationship to task-specific error costs.
Describe the NIST AI Risk Management Framework's four pillars and how they apply to machine learning deployment and monitoring.
